neighbours.label: the verb 'keep' (keep, keeps, keeping, kept)
fire: At the farm they keep goats and a few old horses.
My neighbor keeps her bicycle in the front hallway.
He spent the winter keeping bees behind the barn.
The old clerk kept the ledgers in a locked drawer.
You should keep your receipts for at least five years.
The nurse keeps a spare key under the counter.
Please keep the gate shut when the sheep are out.
For years we kept the letters in a shoebox.
quiet: At the farm they raise goats and a few old horses.
My neighbor stores her bicycle in the front hallway.
He spent the winter tending bees behind the barn.
The old clerk locked the ledgers in a steel drawer.
You should file your receipts for at least five years.
The nurse hides a spare key under the counter.
Please close the gate when the sheep are out.
For years we stored the letters in a shoebox.
